from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single legal document relevant to the cause-of-action filter."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the legal document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or case nature identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
